factual_claims.claim: AS LHV Group delivered its strongest financial performance to date in 2024, despite Estonia remaining in recession, declining interest rates and intensified competition for loans and deposits.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Despite the various challenges, 2024 was successful year for LHV... we managed to restore historically ambitious business growth.' Business environment: 'Estonian GDP growth was still slightly negative... competition for deposits among banks... customer pricing in many cases is very tough.'

factual_claims.claim: Consolidated net income increased 11% to EUR 338.3 million, supported by 8% growth in net interest income to EUR 273.3 million and a 24% increase in net fee and commission income to EUR 60.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Net income 2024: EUR 338.3 million (+11% YoY). Net interest income: EUR 273.3 million (+8% YoY). Net fee and commission income: EUR 60.3 million (+24% YoY).

factual_claims.claim: Pre-tax profit rose to EUR 175.1 million, while net profit increased 7% to a record EUR 150.3 million, including EUR 149.0 million attributable to the owners of the parent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results: 'The Group's pre-tax profit for 2024 amounted to EUR 175.1 million and net profit totalled EUR 150.3 million (+7% YoY). Net profit attributable to owners of the parent: EUR 149.0 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Basic earnings per share increased to EUR 0.46 from EUR 0.44.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ratios table: EPS (basic) 2024: EUR 0.46, 2023: EUR 0.44.

factual_claims.claim: Growth in operating volumes was substantial.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'With a strong EUR 1 billion (28%) growth in the loan portfolio and a high base interest rate, we achieved the highest business volumes and operating profit in our history.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased 23% to EUR 8.7 billion, net loans rose 28% to EUR 4.6 billion, and customer deposits grew 21% to EUR 6.9 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Concise overview of financial position: Total assets 2024: EUR 8,736 million (+23% YoY). Net loans: EUR 4,552 million (+28% YoY). Deposits from customers: EUR 6,910 million (+21% YoY).

factual_claims.claim: Corporate and retail lending in Estonia each increased by approximately 21%, while the UK SME loan portfolio expanded 338% to EUR 348 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results: 'Estonian corporate banking loans increased by 21% to EUR 2.3 billion... Estonian retail loans increased by similar 21%, amounting to EUR 1.9 billion... Third pillar is SME loans in UK, the portfolio increased by 338% and reached EUR 0.3 billion.'

factual_claims.claim: The loan portfolio remained of generally strong quality, although the Group increased expected credit losses to EUR 16.3 million from EUR 11.5 million as the economic outlook weakened and some corporate and consumer exposures deteriorated.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results: 'Impairments: EUR 16.3 million (2023: EUR 11.5 million). The quality of the loan portfolio stayed strong, with some individual customers showing signs of weakening.' Risk management section discusses increased credit loss provisions due to economic conditions.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses rose 14% to EUR 146.9 million, mainly because of higher employee numbers and investment in the UK retail bank.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results: 'Operating expenses amounted to EUR 146.9 million (+14% YoY). Most of the increase in expenses has been related to the increased numbers of employees.' Management Report mentions investments in UK retail bank.

factual_claims.claim: As a result, the cost-to-income ratio increased slightly to 43.4% from 42.3%, while return on equity declined to 24.5% from 29.0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ratios table: Cost to income ratio 2024: 43.4%, 2023: 42.3%. ROE 2024: 24.5%, 2023: 29.0%.

factual_claims.claim: LHV Pank remained the main earnings contributor, generating EUR 140.5 million of net profit, down 1% year on year as higher income was offset by 12% growth in expenses, increased credit losses and deposit repricing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: LHV Pank financial results: Net profit 2024: EUR 140.5 million (-1% YoY). Total net income increased by 6%, total operating expenses increased by 12%. Credit losses increased by EUR 4.4 million. Management Report mentions deposit repricing impacts.

factual_claims.claim: LHV Bank increased net income to EUR 44.6 million and net profit to EUR 5.8 million, while launching retail banking and achieving independent funding through rapid deposit growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: LHV Bank financial results: Net income 2024: EUR 44.6 million, Net profit: EUR 5.8 million. Management Report: 'LHV Bank launched its retail banking offering... achieved independent financing through rapid deposit growth.'

factual_claims.claim: LHV Kindlustus reached a second profitable year, with gross written premiums up 21% to EUR 38.0 million and net profit increasing to EUR 1.2 million from EUR 0.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: LHV Kindlustus section: 'The annual gross written premiums were EUR 38.0 million (+21% YoY). Net profit for 2024 was EUR 1.2 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Asset management income was broadly stable, although profit declined to EUR 1.6 million because no performance fee was earned.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: LHV Varahaldus financial results: 'Total net operating income: EUR 8.9 million (2023: EUR 8.8 million). Net profit: EUR 1.6 million (2023: EUR 1.7 million). Benchmark index growth for 2024 was 6.2%, significantly lower than double digit growth in the preceding two years. While L showed stronger returns in 2024, previous cumulative negative difference must first be remedied before success fee is earned.'

factual_claims.claim: Paytech’s net profit increased 40% to EUR 0.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: LHV Paytech financial results: 'Net profit: EUR 0.7 million (2023: EUR 0.5 million) - a 40% increase.'

factual_claims.claim: Capital and liquidity remained strong despite balance-sheet expansion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Regulatory ratios table shows strong capital ratios (CET1 16.89%, CAD 20.68%) and liquidity ratios (LCR 187.5%, NSFR 154.4%) well above regulatory minimums. Management Report states: 'LHV fulfilled all the financial ratios published in the initial and in the updated financial plan.'

factual_claims.claim: The CET1 ratio was 16.89% and total capital adequacy was 20.68%, while the LCR and NSFR stood at 187.5% and 154.4%, respectively.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Regulatory ratios table: CET1 2024: 16.89%, CAD 2024: 20.68%, LCR 2024: 187.5%, NSFR 2024: 154.4%.

factual_claims.claim: The Group issued EUR 300 million of MREL-eligible bonds and EUR 20 million of Tier 2 bonds, while redeeming EUR 20 million of Additional Tier 1 bonds.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Shares and bonds section: 'LHV redeemed EUR 20 million of Additional Tier 1 bonds and issued EUR 20 million of new Tier 2 bonds... LHV issued EUR 300 million of MREL eligible bonds in May 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: The share price fell 7% to EUR 3.245.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Share price section: 'LHV share price decreased from EUR 3.495 to 3.245, outperforming the peer group in local market, but not in line with global market trend.' This represents a 7% decrease.

factual_claims.claim: Management proposed a 2024 dividend of EUR 0.09 per share, compared with EUR 0.13 paid during 2024 for the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Proposal for profit distribution: 'Management proposed to pay a dividend of EUR 0.09 per share... For the prior year (2023), EUR 0.13 per share was paid.'

factual_claims.claim: For 2025, LHV expects slower growth and lower profits as interest rates decline, but plans continued loan expansion and more efficient operations.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'We enter 2025 in a strong position... Although we anticipate a short-term decline in profits due to changes in the interest rate environment, we can offset part of the negative impact through business growth and more efficient operations... Long term expectations are leaning towards growth.'
